summary: Closed the empty-command question and recorded a synthesis Fact so the run's recovery-value defects share one navigable statement. All six registered questions now carry an explained disposition with an account tied to retained receipts: the value-adoption defect and its committed-value contradiction, the boundary-measured recovery-authority gate, the per-attempt status-guard stall, the empty-command replacement with its order-dependent outcome and its measured client-contract hole, the client-completion protection that holds for the single-NOOP case, and the refuted wrong-row-write suspicion. The new Fact states the family's four distinct mechanisms in one place with their source anchors, receipts and referenced behaviors - the fabricated self value ballot, the ballot-gated adoption that discards genuine replies, the COMMITTED-status adoption that stalls the first attempt, and the empty (nil-on-the-wire) slice that the sub-case fallback passes through with arrival order deciding the command - and notes which countermeasures do not cover which case: recovering replicas that already hold the value are unaffected by the first two, and the client re-offer protects the single-NOOP case but not the empty-slice case. The question's hypothesis was refreshed to the measured trigger-position explanation and its remaining discriminator narrowed to the three unexercised permutations and a reply set with more command-carrying than empty replies. Nothing measured changed in this turn; the run's accounts, receipts and limits otherwise stand as recorded.
